audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer described the lane as flatly even; it is Neeko's through level 3 and Katarina's from 4 on.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and the content whys both say Neeko x3 then Katarina x4, and it is grounded: Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 and is her only setup, so the downtime between roots is the whole matchup.
audit.corrected: Concede to level 3 behind minions, then trade in every Tangle-Barbs cooldown window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and cooldowns fields named no Neeko number.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, Blooming Burst 9s at rank 1, Shapesplitter 16s at rank 1, Pop Blossom 120/105/90s.
audit.corrected: Level 4 is the flip on E's 12s downtime; Pop Blossom is 120s at rank 1, so a dodged one gives you a two-minute lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Interaction text was generic ('the root sets up her whole burst'). The load-bearing facts are that Tangle-Barbs grows when it passes through a champion or kills a unit, and that Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden while she is disguised.
audit.why: Riot's E text: passing through a champion or killing an enemy makes it larger, faster and longer-rooting — so standing behind a minion line is worse than standing off the line. Riot's R text explicitly hides the prep when disguised. Both are hardCC, and Death Lotus is a channel any CC cancels.
audit.corrected: Stand off the minion line, not behind it; and never start Lotus with Tangle-Barbs available, because either that or R cancels the channel outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: brief.missingInteractions claims Katarina's Bouncing Blade (Q) grounds Neeko's Pop Blossom. It does not.
audit.why: The 'grounding' flag on Katarina's Q is a tooltip-parsing misfire on the word 'ricocheting onto the ground'. Riot's own Q text describes only a thrown dagger that bounces and lands — no grounding effect. Per the brief's own rule, the description beats the derived flag.
audit.corrected: Not written. Recorded here and in notes instead of shipped.

notes: IMPORTANT — do not apply brief.missingInteractions key 19. It claims Katarina's Bouncing Blade grounds Neeko's Pop Blossom. Katarina's Q carries a 'grounding' derived flag, but Riot's own Q description ('throws a Dagger... before ricocheting onto the ground') contains no grounding effect; the flag is a tooltip-parse misfire on the word 'ground'. The same false flag will be present on every Katarina brief in this lane, so it should be suppressed run-wide rather than fixed per matchup.
